source.name: better-auth-ui
source.licenseSource: LICENSE file in the pinned tarball; matches the registry metadata
source.compatibilityNote: 3.2.13 is the newest release whose bundle loads against better-auth 1.7.1: 3.2.14+ imports genericOAuthClient from better-auth/client/plugins, which 1.7.1 does not export.

vendored.note: OpenBot wiring around the pinned AuthUIProvider: same auth client, existing TanStack router, declaration gate for organization components.
OpenBot's fixed auth entry wrapping the pinned SignInForm; OpenBot method props arrive with the T01.09 client adapters.
T04.09: entry view composing OpenBot's adapted cards; views ride the existing Router (/organization/$view), listing-derived capabilities decide the writable surface.
T04.09: company profile limited to name/slug/logo via the Directory command adapter (flat ingress body); status read-only; deletion stays a reviewed platform request with no control here.
T04.09: scoped team member add/remove through the T04.08 workspace-scope routes by OpenBot principalId; no company-role or organization write composes here.

AcceptInvitationCard.note: Invitation landing; minimal invitation info via the OpenBot invitations adapter.

CreateOrganizationDialog.note: POST /organization/create is X; provisioning goes through the platform command, not a user-facing create.

DeleteOrganizationCard.note: POST /organization/delete is X; deletion goes through the deletion-request flow.

OrganizationInvitationsCard.note: Server-side pagination and authorization via adapter; list-invitations is an R-class gate read.

OrganizationMembersCard.note: Member listing is an R-class gate read; fixed roles and authorization via adapter.

OrganizationNameCard.note: Profile update through the Directory command adapter.

OrganizationRefetcher.note: Refetch follows native organization hooks; OpenBot adapters own refetch semantics.

OrganizationSlugCard.note: Slug changes follow the platform check-slug rules.

OrganizationSwitcher.note: Built-in discovery reads /organization/list; scope comes from OpenBot workspace-scope.

OrganizationsCard.note: Built-in listing reads /organization/list; adapted to workspace-scope.

UserInvitationsCard.note: Built-in reads include /organization/list-user-invitations; adapted to the OpenBot invitations adapter.

useCurrentOrganization.note: Active organization is only a preference; business scope comes from verified ID pairs, never a native read.
